mentions.name: Small business invoice app
mentions.description: This invoice app for a specific small business was originally built with PHP and MySQL running on XAMPP on a laptop, and has since been migrated to React and Firebase with hosting on Vercel.
mentions.problem: The original setup was tied to a single laptop running XAMPP and had to be migrated when the business moved to a new laptop.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I had built an invoice app for a very specific business with php and mysql and had installed xampp on laptop for them to use so no hosting etc. This was in 2017.
This friend called me couple of months back that he needs the app to be migrated to a new laptop. Until then I had forgotten about this app. I now migrated this app using react and firebase and hosted on vercel.
